data.one_liner: Finds the installation source of the current app package on Android, iOS, and macOS.
data.what_it_does: The store_checker plugin identifies the origin of the currently installed APK or IPA file. It detects if the application was installed from official app stores like Google Play, Apple App Store, TestFlight, or alternative marketplaces and local sources.
use_when: You need to verify if an app was downloaded from an official store versus sideloaded.
You want to handle app behavior differently based on installation channels.
avoid_when: You require detailed user analytics beyond installation source tracking.
Your app targets platforms other than Android, iOS, and macOS.
strengths: Supports a wide array of alternative Android app stores and installers.
Simple asynchronous API for retrieving installation origin.
weaknesses: Limited to specific device platforms (Android, iOS, macOS).
Detection relies heavily on underlying store APIs which may vary by OS version.
data.setup_notes: No explicit permissions are documented in the README; just add the dependency to pubspec.yaml.
